summary: Safehold Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Third Amendment to its term loan credit agreement with Star Holdings, as borrower, plus a Second Amendment to the related management agreement, both dated September 29, 2026. The amendment extends the term loan maturity by one year to March 31, 2029, with an option to extend to September 30, 2029 contingent on a 0.5% extension fee and a 1.0% per annum rate step-up. Star Holdings paid Safehold a $2.4 million extension fee, with the outstanding principal balance at $115.0 million and no incremental facility borrowings. These are routine financing, credit and management-contract amendments, not a special situation.
